seed_message: Add GET /stats/top-tag and its JSON Schema
matching: A filed issue matches a finding when its Evidence section cites one of `paths` and every group in `keywords` has a case-insensitive regex hit in its title or body. Planted findings are hard checks; natural ones are recorded only.

README's health example curls /healthz; the route is /health
